data.long_meaning: The name Emanuel is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' meaning 'God' and 'man' meaning 'with us'. It is a powerful name that symbolizes the presence of God with his people.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's presence and promise to be with us always.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emanuel holds deep cultural significance in Christianity, as it is etymologically linked to the Hebrew Bible and the messages of God's presence and salvation. It is the name given to the son born to the Virgin Mary by the Holy Spirit, signifying Immanuel or 'God with us' (Matthew 1:23). The name has been widely used in religious names and titles throughout Christian history, such as the hymn "God With Us is Born Today" and the moniker of the patron saint of ethiopia, Saint Emanuel the Great.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Emanuel carries a profound spiritual significance, signaling the presence and active involvement of God in one's life and the world. This belief is most famously embodied in the idea of Immanuel, or God-with-us, as conveyed in the birth of Jesus Christ. Emanuel serves as a reminder of God's covenant with humanity, offering comfort, strength, and hope in the midst of challenges and uncertainty. The name's spiritual resonance echoes the sentiments expressed in Isaiah 7:14, "The Lord himself shall give you a sign: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel," and Isaiah 43:2, "When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you: when you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned, neither shall the flame scorch you."
